title: piR‑164552 promotes malignant progression in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma via the RBM4/EIF4E2 signaling axis: Insights from multi‑omics and functional analyses.
snippet: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is a highly aggressive malignancy with limited options for early diagnosis and poor clinical outcomes. In the present study, PIWI‑interacting RNA (piR)‑164552 was identified as a novel oncogenic regulator in HNSCC. piR‑164552 was found to be markedly upregulated in tumor tissues and serum ex...
